title: W11803249 — Service Diagnostic Mode entry
description: Three-key ×3 entry; manual control, auto test, and fault modes.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in Counter-Depth 24 cu ft French Door (W11803249B)

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: Press any 3 keypad buttons three times (1,2,3; 1,2,3; 1,2,3) within 8 s. Hold 1st button 5 s to exit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press any 3 keypad buttons three times (1,2,3; 1,2,3; 1,2,3) within 8 s. Hold 1st button 5 s to exit.
